title: Desk D-S0 entry generation: the judging run (50-packet pilot, then the registered schedule in batches of 200) that produces judged-1/{mask-key.json,proposals.jsonl} for units RQ-20261026-e535-03/-04
note: Filed 2026-10-26 by lane DESK-18-GEN-REPLAY-S0 (session_014Wuw5ZTBbMDhhYNnn9wGJx). WHAT: the only step between the pre-registered entry-generation units and a result. Units RQ-20261026-e535-01 (harness self-check) and -02 (random-entry null, strategy-own comparator, MEASURED sd and the n it implies) are token-free and dispatchable; -03 (arm 1) and -04 (novelty = new subset) score a JUDGED file that does not exist yet. Driver: scripts/research/desk_gen_replay_driver.py (modes selfcheck, baselines, packets, intake, score). BLOCKED ON: the held units PR landing, and RQ-20261026-e535-01 landing with verdict pass (do not spend judging tokens on an uncertified instrument). PROCEDURE (all of it: a lane runs it, it is a manager dispatch with a ceiling). (1) PILOT, nothing scored: python3 scripts/research/desk_gen_replay_driver.py packets --out <scratch> --fetch --seed 20261027 --n 50 (a SEPARATE seed, so no registered cutoff is touched); give each of 50 repo-less Sonnet sessions ONE packet from packets.jsonl plus <scratch>/JUDGE-PROTOCOL.md and nothing else; collect one JSON row each; run the intake mode on the rows; read cost per packet from get_session().usage deltas. NEVER run score on pilot output. The pilot answers two UNMEASURED things: proposals per packet (units -03/-04 declare 0.25 as an assumption) and dollars per packet. Ceiling $3. (2) Re-declare the power blocks of -03/-04 from the measured rate (a power edit; the decision_rule is not touched) in the promotion PR. (3) FULL RUN: packets with the registered seed in batches of 200 (--offset 0, 200, ...), the same judging, intake after every batch; stop when next_batch_allowed is false (800 valid proposals counted before any replay, or 1,500 packets). Commit comms/research/desk_gen_replay/judged-1/mask-key.json and proposals.jsonl only. The judge must not read the repo (the key goes public once committed). (4) The manager promotes -03 and -04 (git mv out of blocked/, remove blocked_on). COST PER DECISION POINT (one masked packet, one call): packet 16,912 characters median over 40 packets MEASURED 2026-10-26 (about 4.8 k tokens at 3.5 characters per token, INFERRED) + protocol 2,397 characters (about 0.7 k) + about 0.4 k output (assumed). Dollars UNMEASURED: floor about $0.001 (blended Sonnet $0.17 per million tokens from design 7 x 5.9 k tokens, which ignores the uncached-input price); ceiling $0.021 to $0.041 (design 5.3, a Sonnet call or working wake at a 122 k standing context, +-2x, which a stateless call is far below). 1,500 packets: about $1.5 to $62. The pilot replaces this bracket with a number. DONE WHEN: judged-1 is on main and -03/-04 have landed results. landed_unproven is NOT done.
